# Test data

Small, synthetic, rights-clear fixtures for the C++ import tests (`tests/cpp`). Nothing here comes
from a commercial recording or a third-party image. Every file is generated by
[`make_fixtures.py`](make_fixtures.py) from sine tones, solid-colour/gradient images, and
hand-assembled ID3v2 tags.

The tests read these files in place through the `SNDS_TESTDATA_DIR` compile definition
(`tests/cpp/CMakeLists.txt`). WAV fixtures are not stored: the tests write every WAV variant at
runtime (PCM 8/16/24/32-bit, float 32/64-bit, extensible, RF64, multichannel, >192 kHz, truncated,
and WAVs with an `id3 ` chunk holding APIC artwork).

## Regenerating

```powershell
worker\.venv\Scripts\python.exe testdata\make_fixtures.py
```

The worker environment already contains the two encoders used: `lameenc` (LAME, writes no Xing/LAME
header) and `soundfile` (libsndfile 1.2.2 with LAME, writes a Xing frame with the LAME gapless tag).
The output is byte-identical between runs with the pinned environment.

## Files (`import/`)

| File | Bytes | Content | Used to test |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `tone-stereo-44k1.mp3` | 16718 | 1 s, 44.1 kHz stereo, 440/660 Hz, CBR 128 kbps (lameenc), no tags | Plain MP3 acceptance, exact length, no-artwork path, JUCE decode lag (1105 samples) |
| `tone-stereo-44k1-apic.mp3` | 20630 | Same audio plus an ID3v2.3 tag: `TIT2`, an APIC "other" picture (16x16 orange PNG) **before** an APIC front cover (48x32 gradient PNG) | Front-cover preference, embedded artwork decode |
| `tone-mono-48k-v24-unsync.mp3` | 12038 | 1 s, 48 kHz mono, 330 Hz, CBR 64 kbps, ID3v2.4 tag with extended header, tag and frame unsynchronisation, and data length indicators, APIC front cover | ID3v2.4 parsing on a real file, mono MP3 |
| `tone-stereo-48k-lametag.mp3` | 6984 | 1 s, 48 kHz stereo, 220/550 Hz, VBR via libsndfile: Xing frame with 43 frames, LAME delay 576, padding 960 | Xing/LAME parsing, exact length, JUCE decode lag with a LAME tag |
| `tone-mono-22k05-mpeg2.mp3` | 2299 | 0.5 s, 22.05 kHz mono MPEG-2 Layer III, 32 kbps | Rejection of low-sample-rate (MPEG-2) MP3 |

Total: about 57 KB.

All tones are 16-bit, at −12 dBFS, with 10 ms linear fades, as generated by `sine_pcm16()` in the
script. The lag test in `SongImportTests.cpp` rebuilds the same signal to measure decoder alignment.
